# Aura Sports Group

> Aura Sports Group (aurasmg.com) is a football representation agency. We represent premier athletes and coaches at every stage of the game — from NFL contract strategy, to college NIL representation, high school recruiting, and coaching representation — plus brand and marketing support that builds value on and off the field.

Aura Sports Group is a distinct company from unrelated businesses that also use "Aura Sports" in their name (for example sports-flooring or local sports-club brands). The company's site is https://aurasmg.com and its socials are linked below.

## Representation

- [NFL Representation](https://aurasmg.com/nfl): Career-long NFL representation built around the athlete's complete career — contract strategy, concierge care, brand, and life beyond the game.
- [College NIL Representation](https://aurasmg.com/college-nil): NIL representation for college football players.
- [Recruits](https://aurasmg.com/recruits): Representation for elite high school athletes, a natural entry point into the college pathway.
- [Coaches](https://aurasmg.com/coaches): Career representation for football coaches.
- [Representation Overview](https://aurasmg.com/representation): How Aura's approach evolves across every stage of a football career.

## Company

- [The Agency](https://aurasmg.com/the-agency): Who Aura Sports Group is and how the firm approaches representation.
